description: A Java class for an Android game view implementing joystick controls, rendering, and game logic for a physics-based spaceship game with obstacles and bullets.

classes.name: GameView
classes.description: Custom Android View implementing a joystick-controlled spaceship game with obstacles, bullets, and collision detection.

classes.name: Sprite
classes.description: Abstract base class for game objects with position, velocity, size, and destruction animation.

classes.name: Ship
classes.description: Represents a controllable spaceship with input handling, rendering, and firing capabilities.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: Represents a projectile fired by ships.

classes.name: Obstacle
classes.description: Represents obstacles in the game environment.

methods.name: findControllersAndAttachShips
methods.description: Detects connected input devices and creates ships for gamepads or joysticks.

methods.name: getShipForId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Ship instance associated with a device ID, assigning colors based on device descriptors.

methods.name: removeShipForID
methods.description: Removes a ship associated with a specific device ID.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears game objects and re-detects controllers.

methods.name: animateFrame
methods.description: Advances game state and redraws the view.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Updates positions, handles collisions, and spawns obstacles based on elapsed time.
